page.notes: Greek accents and breathings in the Pindar scholia are read from a small, faded scan; words marked as doubtful were not confirmed letter by letter. The Greek in "Κυανα υγὲς ἐν ὀρφνᾷ" and "ὑποδαφλωσαι" is uncertain. The Greek heading "Εὐδῆς Αἰολίδα" is uncertain. The verse reference line is printed as "Strophe 4.versuum.11." and is given as printed.
